8035.title: Spending controls exclude unused Codex capacity
8035.rootCauseOneLine: Codex spending observations become account-wide restrictions that exclude even allowed, unused plan windows before any upstream request.
8035.proposedFix: First verify upstream spending semantics; changing the documented hard-stop policy requires a product decision, so no automatic production fix was attempted.
8035.caveats: Both clean local runs reproduce 429 with zero upstream inference calls; real-account entitlement and upstream acceptance remain unverified. Reproduction code and output are inline.
